BAR B (THE FALSIFIER): mean paired delta <= 0 on two or more seeds => store-in-the-loop features do NOT beat encoder-alone at equal compute, and that is the reported result. SECONDARY (declared in advance as secondary and never quotable as BAR A): all three deltas > 0.
